links.comparator_used: Baseline GPT-4 Turbo answering every case without a confidence threshold (55.1% baseline accuracy)
links.outcome: Diagnostic precision and misdiagnosis rate in 751 neuroradiology cases
links.effect: Top diagnosis precision rose from 55.1% baseline to 72.9% with a 90% confidence threshold. The five-candidate list contained the correct diagnosis in 85.9% of cases, and the misdiagnosis rate fell to 14.1%. This effect was combined with the five-candidate output format and was not isolated.
links.tradeoff: The threshold reduced the number of cases that received a response.
links.quote: By reformatting responses to list five diagnostic candidates and applying a 90% confidence threshold, the highest precision of the diagnosis increased to 72.9%, with the candidate list providing the correct diagnosis at 85.9%, reducing the misdiagnosis rate to 14.1%.
